content: Prologue: I liked it, great intro but 22nd century? so soon? Maybe 23rd give us another 200  yrs  to fuck it all up. Liked the simple explanations about the end and how humanity thot they'd survive. I still think the VI Sentinel should deactivate upon divulging the intel he needs upon landing. Just a thot. After all, they're seeding the Earth...a Genesis of a sort. Chapter 1) I fell for dear Marcus. Great Chapter. It sets the stage so nicely for the rest of the story. He lands, he's adapting, feels weird and gets his ducks in a row. Then he wonders about the others. I still think perhaps he could utilize his VI Sentinel to get set up and organized.  Allow her to direct him to supplies and possible humanity, then she deactivates. Otherwise  it's a fine opening. I feel his anxiety, excitement, and hope. Chapter 2) He finally, after so much difficulty, finds the wee home of Orah. I love how they interact. She is so delicate and soft yet tough as stone. However, Sentinel sweeps up into the rafters of the porch as he ascends it and is never hear from again.  ( thus  why I thot she loses power after he's set to travel and is gone. I liked her stories a lot. How the "Gods" ended life only to rebirth it BUT without technology.  ( love  that) I  ike  the new "religion", it feels very pagan. Blue crystal ammunition reminded me of the old song "Crystal Blue Persuasion". Marcus's reaction the  the  crystals was just as mine would've been, and I "love" the flying ships w/ sails! We, the reader, get the timeline of 1000 years which is important because, as of about now, the reader is wondering. Then, 200  yrs  ago Magus hunts,  Good  vs Bad, the point to eliminate the bad. felt like the old witch hunts, to create a Utopian society. ( good  luck w/ that) Chapter 3) Warden Corliss. LOVE her. Mal meets Laura Croft child. Tough, funny, intense don't fuck w/ me attitude. She can do it all impression.  Maybe a bit more  descriptives  about her appearance. I saw tall rail thin yet whipcord strong, curly dark blonde hair w/ ice blue eyes, long fingered hands? close?  Chapter 4) Rogan A huge sycophant to the Empress. One instantly is offended by his mind and being. I think I'll love hating this guy. Chapter 5 Nero Young sweet cleric/messenger. You can't help but love him. He's just "good". Chapter 6) Marcus A wonderful chapter. Tentative Marcus falling in love, torn between searching on for more or staying and just being happy and content. Then each declares the love and become betrothed. "I cheered". Great moment when she "tells" him to move to her room. Chapter 7) Corliss (and  Galin  her father) The world here feels quite Medieval. I like it. Love the horse lamp. But the horses: 3 times a chestnut horse is what Corliss rides except the time she reaches for her brown appaloosa, oops. I like how she goes on her "mission" to find the crash site of the silver tear and hopefully it's occupant. Chapter 8) Rogan  At  the tower, incredible  descriptives . I was wrinkling my nose at the stench and felt the horror, then his shock when the Empress is behind him. Whoa! Shocker. THEN, his becoming one of her "special" soldiers. Shudder, again great  descriptives . Chapter 9 Nero,  Korlin , &  Jorun  seeking the 5  yr  old. Shows the depth of feeling on Nero's part and his willingness to step up and be forthright. I was sad when the hunter sacrificed himself so they could escape. The things would scare me to death. Chapter 10) Marcus Home from setting up the betrothal to find the cabin aflame and Orah within burned and dead. This broke the reader's heart. When he carries her out and sees the tax collectors and gathers the power and kills them all. Your reader will thrill  tho  they are so sad over his loss. This chapter defines the rest for Marcus, he changes, becomes... Chapter 11 Maelen OH a Texas accent and all, love this character. He makes a man, a warrior out of Marcus. Great to add he's only had 20  yrs  to adapt. The story about the cycle of man clarifies  alot . Training is  good nice  timeline. I love the rabbit  zen  thingy, getting inside their little minds to plant a picture, then "big nasty sharp pointy teeth" made laugh out loud  ie  Monty Python nudge. Great chapter. ( on  a personal note: I think, in time, Marcus and Corliss would be an incredible couple story. Avengers fighting the evil Queen for good...and the  never ending  bickering they'd have because both are so strong...as well and the devoted love and loyalty? Just a thought) Chapter 12) Corliss Can't find Marcus. But she's Corliss, c'mon she should be pounding tables, eyes flashing with frustration and rage. Time to gather her posse of wardens and hit the trail and "make" things happen. I just don't feel she'd sit in a bar for a month feeling sorry for herself.  You've painted her so strongly. A few days of wallowing would be human but then...load up folks we're off to find him.  ( so  to speak) Love  Durass  the  Silven , but perhaps can his name have one less S?  Duras ? My warped mind kept says Dumbass lol, sorry, and he isn't. Chapter 13) Rogan I have come to loathe and fear this new Rogan. Being 1 of the 12, he changes radically to pure evil and loves it.  Gives the reader shudders and pause. I fear for Marcus and Maelen once Loric delivers his message.  Amazing chapter,  can't wait to see the next. Chapter 14) Marcus & Maelen Amazing part however I had to pause and reread to be sure which (Marcus or Maelen) beheaded the Seer.  I clarified it upon slowly rereading. Epilogue Marcus & Maelen  War is declared, ok that was expected.  Wardens scattered (how Corliss is a warden, where is she?)  Church  decimated,  the Order agrees to join the Empress.  I'll be honest, I wanted more clarification (story) here.  It left me feeling flat with no hope to the next book.  I like to leave a book with anticipation of the next.  The epilogue just  sorta  cataloged;  so  this and this and this happened "The End". All in all, I love it and became very attached to the characters, good and bad. Now on to read more of the Black Queen.
